steps.title: Toolchains, workspaces, Turborepo graph and root scripts
steps.summary: Sets up the empty monorepo: pinned toolchains in mise, Bun workspaces, the Turborepo graph behind `bun run check`, every npm package and mise tool in the spec's Libraries table, the real `step:verify` script, and a stub for each other root script so later steps only fill their own folder.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run step:verify M0-S01
criteria: `mise install` then `bun install --frozen-lockfile` on a clean macOS machine succeed with `MISE_LOCKED=1`.
M0-S01 installs every npm package and mise tool in the Libraries table; no later step's diff touches `bun.lock`, `mise.toml` or `mise.lock`.

Root scripts `codegen`, `gates:canaries`, `guard`, `lint:docs`, `voidx`, `e2e`, `qa:validate`, `format`, `check:mac-ui` and `snapshots:record` exist and exit 0 until their step fills them; `step:verify` fails on an id with no tests or canaries.

steps.title: Tokens: DTCG source, Terrazzo, CSS and Tailwind output, contrast test
steps.summary: Builds the design-token source for Dragonfruit and Neon Night, type, spacing, radius and motion, generates CSS and Tailwind `@theme`, and tests that every colour pair is readable and inside sRGB.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/design-tokens && bun run step:verify M0-S02
criteria: Every colour token is inside the sRGB gamut, and the contrast test passes for every token pair in light and dark.
Every motion token has a value in the `reduced` context, `stagger` is 0 there and every reduced spring has bounce 0.

steps.title: Tokens: voidx-native plugin for Swift, xcassets and spring linear()
steps.summary: Adds our own Terrazzo plugin that writes Swift tokens, colour assets and spring curves to `packages/design-tokens/Generated/`, with a test that each spring settles on time.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/design-tokens && bun run step:verify M0-S03

steps.title: Core: domain types and port interfaces
steps.summary: Writes the domain model every part shares (positions, pools, tokens, chains, prices as optional values) and the port interfaces in the spec's Ports table, each method taking an AbortSignal. Types only.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/core && bun run step:verify M0-S04

steps.title: Contracts: Zod schemas, OpenAPI files, fixtures, mock
steps.summary: Defines the first draft of the API contract, the generated `openapi.json` and Swift variant, example fixtures including unknown enum values, and the mock API the app uses before a server exists.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/contracts && bun run codegen --filter=@voidx/contracts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/contracts && bun run step:verify M0-S05
criteria: `oasdiff breaking` fails between `openapi.json` and a copy with one field removed.
A fixture with an unknown enum value decodes in `bun run check --filter=@voidx/contracts`.

steps.title: Integration kit schemas, voidx validate, chain files, infra stub
steps.summary: Creates the schemas every chain and protocol file must pass, the `PositionIndex` sources that read only through `ChainReader` and `IndexTransport`, compile-only Uniswap V3 and V4 adapter stubs, the `voidx validate` command, the Ethereum and Arbitrum chain files and the empty `infra` package.
steps.done_when: bun run voidx validate && bun run check --filter=@voidx/integration-kit --filter=@voidx/cli --filter=@voidx/infra --filter=@voidx/integrations && bun run step:verify M0-S06
criteria: `bun run voidx validate` passes on `integrations/chains/*` and fails on a canary chain file with a misspelled key and on one with an address without a source URL.

Every method of every port in [Ports](#ports) takes an `AbortSignal`; the `uniswap-v3` and `uniswap-v4` adapter stubs typecheck with `satisfies ProtocolAdapter`, and a canary stub without `snapshot` fails `tsc` with `TS1360`.

steps.title: Server and worker: createRoot, /livez, one test each
steps.summary: Starts the server and worker apps, each with a composition root and one test; the server answers `/livez`. No database yet.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/server --filter=@voidx/worker && bun run step:verify M0-S07
criteria: `GET /livez` on the server returns 200 in its test.

steps.title: Gate runner and dependency-cruiser rules with canaries
steps.summary: Fills the canary runner (`bun run gates:canaries`), which discovers every `canary.json` by folder convention, and adds the import-boundary rules with canaries proving they fail.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run step:verify M0-S08
criteria: `bun run gates:canaries` fails on a canary folder without `canary.json` fields, on a canary whose tool passes, and on a filter that matches no canary.
dependency-cruiser fails on canary imports from `integrations/` into `packages/infra`, from a server route into `infra`, and into a non-exported `core` path.

steps.title: Biome rules and GritQL plugins with canaries
steps.summary: Turns on the Biome rules from the code style, the GritQL plugins against literal motion values, `z.enum` wire fields and decorators, each with a canary.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run step:verify M0-S09
criteria: Biome fails on a canary `fetch` in `integrations/` and in `packages/integration-kit`, a `z.enum` wire field in `packages/contracts`, a decorator in `packages/`, and an `` without `alt` in Hono JSX; CI fails on a canary `biome-ignore` under `integrations/`.
A canary literal colour fails lint in CSS.
A canary file breaking one code-style rule fails: a floating promise and a default export in TS.
A canary literal duration fails lint in CSS: `transition: opacity 300ms`.

steps.title: License gate with a canary
steps.summary: Adds the dependency-license check so an MIT package can never pull in a GPL dependency.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run step:verify M0-S10
criteria: The license gate fails on a canary GPL dependency in an MIT package.

steps.title: Quiet checks, .logs/, format command and format hook
steps.summary: Makes checks agent-friendly: quiet on success, full logs in `.logs/`, a format command, and a hook that formats every file an agent edits by calling mise-pinned binaries directly.
steps.done_when: CLAUDECODE=1 bun run check && bun run step:verify M0-S11
criteria: With `CLAUDECODE=1`, `bun run check` prints nothing on success; on a failing canary it prints only the failure and the path of the full log.
The format hook, fed the hook JSON for a misformatted canary `.ts` and `.swift` file, formats each, exits 0 and prints nothing; its command calls `mise exec` and `xcrun` binaries, not a repo script.
steps.owner_reason: Adds the PostToolUse hook to the committed `.claude/settings.json`, which changes only with your approval.

steps.title: lint:docs and REUSE
steps.summary: Adds the docs checks: links and anchors, Markdown structure, every AGENTS.md path exists, every skill has its link, and licence headers via REUSE.
steps.done_when: bun run lint:docs && reuse lint && bun run step:verify M0-S12
criteria: `reuse lint` and `bun run lint:docs` (offline) pass; `lint:docs` fails on a canary `AGENTS.md` path that does not exist and on a skill without its `.claude/skills/` link.

steps.title: Guard scripts and Renovate config
steps.summary: Writes the PR guard (DCO sign-off, lockfile guard, integration path allowlist, owner label for snapshot, canary and threshold changes, workflow pinning and no-retry checks) as local scripts with a self-test, and the Renovate config with a 7-day release age.
steps.done_when: bun run guard --self-test && bun run renovate-config-validator && bun run step:verify M0-S13
criteria: `guard --self-test` fails: a commit without `Signed-off-by:`; a lockfile change under an integration-only diff; an integration diff with a path outside the allowlist; a snapshot, canary or protected threshold change without the `owner-approved` label.
`guard --workflows` fails on canary workflows with an action pinned by tag, with `permissions: write-all`, and with a test retry on `pull_request`.
`renovate-config-validator` passes on the Renovate config.

steps.title: Screenshot review rubric, QA report validator, spec-verifier agent
steps.summary: Writes the rubric agents use to judge screenshots, the `qa:validate` script that checks agent QA and spec-verifier reports, and the read-only spec-verifier agent. You approve the rubric.
steps.done_when: bun run lint:docs && bun run step:verify M0-S14
steps.owner_reason: The rubric decides what agents call good or bad UI and the agent file lives in `.claude/`; you approve both.

steps.title: iOS: Tuist project with every target
steps.summary: Creates the iOS, iPadOS and macOS project with Tuist, declaring every module, test target, the widget stub and SPM dependencies up front, so later steps never touch the manifest.
steps.done_when: tuist install && tuist generate --no-open && tuist inspect dependencies --only implicit && test "$(git ls-files apps/ios-app | grep -c '\.entitlements$')" = 0
criteria: iOS: `tuist install && tuist generate --no-open` and `tuist inspect dependencies --only implicit` pass; `git ls-files apps/ios-app | grep -c '\.entitlements$'` prints 0.
`git grep -l xyz.depthly.voidx apps/` lists only the Tuist constant file.

steps.title: iOS: generated APIClient and unknown-enum decode test
steps.summary: Generates the Swift API client from `openapi.swift.json` inside the iOS workspace's `codegen` task, which runs only on macOS, and proves an unknown enum value decodes safely.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S16
criteria: A fixture with an unknown enum value decodes in `--filter=@voidx/ios`.

steps.title: iOS: check wrapper, toolchain file, Mac UI and snapshot-record scripts
steps.summary: Makes `bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios` run the iPhone and iPad simulator tests and the macOS build and unit tests quietly, from the pinned values in `apps/ios-app/toolchain.json`, failing early on another Xcode build; adds `check:mac-ui` and `snapshots:record`.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S17
criteria: `bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios` reads `apps/ios-app/toolchain.json`, fails early on another Xcode build, runs the tests on the iPhone and iPad simulators and the macOS build and unit tests; `xcodebuild build -scheme VoidXWidgets` passes for iOS and macOS.
`bun run check:mac-ui` runs the Mac UI audit (owner-run).
With `CI`, `CLAUDECODE=1` or `AGENT=1` set, a missing snapshot fails instead of recording; `bun run snapshots:record` records.
steps.owner_reason: Fill the exact Xcode build, iOS runtime and device names in `apps/ios-app/toolchain.json`.

steps.title: iOS data layer: mock transport, repository, launch arguments
steps.summary: Adds the data layer that reads the mock API and the Debug-only launch arguments `apiBase`, `scenario` and `route`, with unit tests that a Release build ignores `route`.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S18

steps.title: iOS lint gates: SwiftLint strict, custom rules, canaries
steps.summary: Turns on SwiftLint strict with the code-style rules and custom rules against literal colours and motion values, each registered as a canary.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S19
criteria: A canary literal colour fails lint in Swift.
A canary file breaking one code-style rule fails: `ObservableObject` and `DispatchQueue` in Swift.
A canary literal duration fails lint in Swift: `.animation(.easeIn(duration: 0.3))`.

steps.title: core-green-web: everything the web UI needs passes
steps.summary: Checkpoint, not code: tokens, core, contracts, kit, server and all TS gates pass together. No M0 web step follows it (web UI moved to M1b); M0-G2 builds on it.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter='!@voidx/ios' && bun run codegen --filter='!@voidx/ios' && git diff --exit-code && bun run gates:canaries --platform linux
criteria: `bun run codegen --filter='!@voidx/ios' && git diff --exit-code` shows no changes on Linux, and `bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code` shows none on macOS.

steps.title: core-green-ios: everything the iOS UI needs passes
steps.summary: Checkpoint, not code: the shared core plus the iOS project, client, data layer and gates pass before iOS UI work starts.
steps.done_when: bun run check && bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code && bun run gates:canaries
criteria: `bun run check` passes on macOS; `bun run check --filter='!@voidx/ios'` passes on Linux.

steps.title: iOS UI kit v0 in DesignSystem
steps.summary: Builds the same pieces in SwiftUI from generated tokens only, each with its motion, reduced-motion branch and accessibility labels.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S21

steps.title: iOS placeholder screen and gallery route
steps.summary: Adds a placeholder Portfolio screen fed by the mock API and the Debug-only gallery opened with `route=gallery`, both using only the UI kit.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S22
criteria: Launching the iOS app with `route=gallery` shows the gallery, and the Maestro smoke flow asserts one id from it; a Release build ignores `route`.

steps.title: E2E harness: Prism, Maestro flows, simulator prepare
steps.summary: Adds the script that starts the mock API, the Maestro smoke flow and subflows, and a script that sets simulator state so screenshots repeat.
steps.done_when: bun run e2e --platform ios && bun run step:verify M0-S23
criteria: `bun run e2e` starts Prism on `openapi.mock.json`.
`bun run e2e` passes the smoke flow on the iPhone simulator; a canary flow asserting a removed id fails.

steps.title: Motion check on the simulator
steps.summary: Runs the motion tests on the simulator: every animation has its reduced branch and each iOS spring settles within 5% of its web duration.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S24
criteria: The settling time of each spring on iOS is within 5% of its web `linear()` duration.

steps.title: Accessibility gates: audits and AX5 snapshots
steps.summary: Runs the accessibility audit on iPhone and iPad (Mac in CI and `check:mac-ui`) and records snapshots at default and AX5 text in light, dark and right-to-left with record mode `.never` outside `snapshots:record`. You approve the first baselines.
steps.done_when: bun run check --filter=@voidx/ios && bun run step:verify M0-S25
criteria: A canary unlabeled button fails `performAccessibilityAudit()`; a canary label truncated at AX5 fails its snapshot.
steps.owner_reason: The first snapshot baselines define what correct looks like, and the macOS UI test needs your one-time permission.

steps.title: Agent QA pass on the simulator
steps.summary: An agent drives the running iOS app on fixture data, reads the UI tree, takes screenshots, judges them with the rubric and writes findings; findings never fail the step. The browser pass moved to M1b.
steps.done_when: bun run qa:validate .artifacts/agent-qa/m0-skeleton.json
criteria: `bun run qa:validate .artifacts/agent-qa/m0-skeleton.json` passes on the agent QA report and fails on a report missing a rubric item.

steps.title: CI workflow, issue forms and PR template
steps.summary: Writes the single `ci.yml` (change detection, guard, check on Linux, the iOS job with the Maestro smoke step and Swift codegen drift check, canaries in both jobs, toolchain values from `apps/ios-app/toolchain.json`, `ci-ok` as the one required check), CODEOWNERS, the issue forms and the PR template.
steps.done_when: bun run guard --workflows && bun run guard --codeowners
criteria: `ci.yml` runs `gates:canaries --platform linux` in `check`, `--platform ios` and the Swift codegen drift check in `ios`, and reads Xcode and destinations only from `apps/ios-app/toolchain.json`; `guard --workflows` passes on it.
`.github/CODEOWNERS` covers every gate and config path named in [Scope](#scope): `bun run guard --codeowners` passes, and `guard --self-test` fails on a protected path missing from it.
A PR touching only `docs/` runs `changes`, `guard` and `ci-ok`, and skips `check` and `ios`; `ci-ok` is the single required check (owner-run).

A PR commit without `Signed-off-by:` fails `guard`; a PR adding a lockfile change under an integration-only diff fails `guard`; a PR touching `integrations/` and `packages/core/` fails `guard` (owner-run).
The measured `ios` job time on the M0 PR is recorded in [ci](../research/repo/ci.md) (owner-run).
Every item in [CI settings](#ci-settings-owner-run) is set (owner-run).
steps.owner_reason: CI runs on GitHub with settings only you can change: the ruleset, code-owner review, SHA pinning, token permissions and the `owner-approved` label.

steps.title: Verify every acceptance criterion
steps.summary: A fresh read-only spec-verifier re-runs every acceptance criterion of the M0 spec and writes a report; the step exits on that report, and criteria that need a real PR are listed as owner-run.
steps.done_when: bun run qa:validate --spec-verifier .artifacts/spec-verifier/m0-skeleton.json
criteria: All acceptance criteria in the spec.
